stories.title: Only 8% of fund managers report improved investment returns from AI adoption
stories.simple_summary: Most fund managers who tried using AI to pick investments did not see their returns get better. Only 8 out of every 100 reported actually making more money.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're thinking about letting AI pick your investments or retirement funds, know that it's not proven to work well yet. Talk to your regular financial advisor before making any changes.

stories.title: China's economic growth picks up as AI boom boosts exports
stories.simple_summary: China's economy is growing faster because companies are selling more AI-related products to other countries around the world.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly affects large international businesses and investors. If you run a small local business, this probably won't change your day-to-day work.

stories.title: If I Could Only Own 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Memory Stock for the Next 5 Years, It Wouldn't Be Micron.
stories.simple_summary: An investment expert thinks a certain AI memory company is not the best choice if you want to own just one AI stock for the next five years.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for people picking stocks to invest in. There's nothing you need to do unless you're actively managing investments.

stories.title: AI Cloud Firm Nscale Faces Investor Pushback Over IPO Valuation
stories.simple_summary: A company called Nscale that provides AI computer services wants to sell shares to the public, but investors think the company is asking for too much money.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and business analysts. It doesn't affect small business owners right now.

stories.title: Elder Gong proposes a new test for AI: Humanity’s First Exam
stories.simple_summary: Someone named Elder Gong is suggesting a new way to test whether AI systems are actually intelligent and capable.
stories.why_it_matters: This is interesting to people who study AI, but it won't change how you use AI tools in your daily life or business.

stories.title: Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI, decided to give 5% of its company ownership to a fund designed to benefit the public rather than just make investors richer.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows one AI company trying to think about its impact on society. It's a nice gesture but doesn't directly affect how you use AI.

stories.title: The AI industry’s gigantic debts are making investors nervous
stories.simple_summary: AI companies have borrowed a lot of money to build their systems, and this big debt is starting to worry the people who invested money in them.
stories.why_it_matters: If AI companies fail because of debt, some AI tools might become less available or more expensive. For now, keep using the tools you rely on, but watch for price increases.

stories.title: A woman was arrested in Philly for blocking a delivery robot
stories.simple_summary: A woman in Philadelphia was arrested for standing in front of a delivery robot to protest it, believing it takes jobs away from human delivery workers.
stories.why_it_matters: Delivery robots are starting to appear in some cities and may eventually replace some delivery jobs. This is worth watching if you're in a field that could be affected.

stories.title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI’s workforce
stories.simple_summary: Disney hired most of the workers from a company called Character.AI that made AI chatbots designed to chat with people like real characters.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows big companies are buying up AI talent and businesses. If you use chat-based AI tools, the service might change or improve under new ownership.

stories.title: Anthropic’s proposed AI safety bill only kicks in if 50 deaths or $1 billion in damages are on the line — proposal would effectively make the Commerce Department the only agency capable of stopping an AI model
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic suggested new safety rules for AI, but the rules would only kick in if an AI system causes 50 deaths or over one billion dollars in damage.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to lawmakers and tech industry people. It shows there's disagreement about how strictly to regulate AI, but rules don't exist yet.

stories.title: World Bank says ‘small AI’ could transform developing countries
stories.simple_summary: The World Bank thinks smaller, simpler AI tools could help poor countries solve problems like education and healthcare more easily than huge expensive AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about international development policy. If you run a small business, this doesn't change what you're doing today.

stories.title: Epstein gave $100K to UNM for artificial intelligence research in 2001
stories.simple_summary: An old news story came to light showing that a man named Epstein gave money to a university for AI research back in 2001.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a historical detail about AI funding that doesn't affect you today. It's mostly relevant to people studying the history of AI.
